description: Revised 2026-09-15 conditional wheelchair tag profile, not a physical safety guarantee. Shares primary defaults with BVI; agreement cannot establish model independence. Roadway width/surface are not used as sidewalk measurements.

sidewalk.comment: Missing sidewalk evidence is unresolved, not evidence of physical absence. Separately mapped sidewalks do not establish an additional passing centreline geometry.

pedestrianWays.comment: Dedicated pedestrian infrastructure is PASS unless something contradicts it.

crossing.comment: Primary PASS requires lowered/flush kerb or affirmative wheelchair evidence. Explicit blocking kerb or wheelchair evidence dominates.

steps.comment: Steps are impassable in a wheelchair unless an explicit ramp exists.

surface.comment: Declared wheelchair surface exclusions. The raw surface diagnostic is not a physical quality assessment.

minUsableComponentKmComment: A declared fragmentation convention, not proof of trip usefulness. Eligible metrics threshold eligible component mass; legacy graph metrics threshold total admitted mass.
